title: Magical Mirror Portal
description: A surreal fantasy scene centered on an ornate black oval mirror reflecting five glowing fairies swirling around a golden magical vortex. In the foreground, three cats sit on pink pillows: an orange tabby, a grey cat, and a black cat wearing a checkered cape holding a pink smartphone. A pink armored knight takes a photo while a large green praying mantis perches atop the mirror.
prompt: A highly detailed fantasy illustration shows an ornate black oval mirror floating in a garden of pink flowers under a starry purple sky with a distant castle. Inside the mirror, five glowing fairies with blue wings dance around a swirling golden vortex. In front, three cats sit on pink cushions: an orange tabby, grey cat, and a black cat in a checkered cape taking a selfie with a pink phone. A pink knight in armor photographs the scene while a giant green praying mantis rests on top of the mirror frame, surrounded by glowing bubbles and lit candles.
